message.content: "Cayenne" is a McCartney composition (an instrumental from his pre-Beatles Quarrymen-era repertoire, credited to McCartney alone). The others are by Lennon ("Real Love"), Ringo Starr ("Don't Pass Me By"), and Harrison ("Long, Long, Long").
message.reasoning_content: Cayenne is McCartney (McCartney–Lennon? Actually credited Lennon–McCartney). Others: Real Love (Lennon), Don't Pass Me By (Ringo), Long Long Long (Harrison). So Cayenne.
